# 台架试验与验证

_Test Beds & Validation_

台架试验把验证问题、试验对象、工况和测量手段联系起来。整理公开资料时，可从部件、核心机、整机及系统试验的不同层级建立索引。

_A test connects a validation question to a test article, operating conditions and measurements. Organise public references by component, core, whole-engine and system test levels._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 先写清楚本次试验想验证什么，以及结果支持到什么范围。

_State what the test is intended to establish and how far its findings can be applied._

- 记录试验构型、环境条件、标定状态和数据处理版本。

_Record configuration, environmental conditions, calibration state and processing revisions._

- 将模型对比、重复试验和异常情况与原始结果一起保留。

_Retain model comparisons, repeat tests and anomalies alongside the original results._
